ankit: I'll open PR with a regression test for long-context tokenization and start an eval run against the canary prompts

sre-oncall: monitoring for 30m, will escalate if anything looks off

ryan: adding postmortem placeholder, assign to @maria and @ankit, tagging infra and runtime teams
deploy-bot: Note: canary for release-2026-03-19-4 aborted and marked bad. Manual pins prevent auto-roll-forward. If you need the original tag redeployed after fixes, create a redeploy request and reference INF-4521.

maria: thanks — closing this thread. Will share postmortem when initial triage is done.
